a:r.a:t: Comprehensive testing is mandatory — not optional
Quality is treated as a release gate, not a best-effort activity.
Isolate and test individual components, services, and business logic in isolation.
Verify component interactions, database operations, and external service integrations.
End-to-end API contract testing, response validation, and error scenario coverage.
Idempotency verification, retry policy validation, and regression safety checks.
No deployment without passing all test stages.
